verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents a broad REST API covering order submission (Checkout/Sale), decision retrieval, chargebacks, representment outcomes, guarantee cancellation and webhook creation. Nothing in the evidence claims API–UI parity, and Decision Center policy configuration appears to happen at checkpoints with no documented API for it. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage for Decision Center policy and rule management, account/team administration endpoints, and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: This document will show you how to use Signifyd's REST API to authenticate, make requests, and retrieve data.
Retrieve the latest fraud decision for an order in the Signifyd system.
To create a chargeback against an Order in the Signifyd system, you need to record a Chargeback Event.
Create a new webhook. This will add to the list of any existing webhooks.
If Decision Center is enabled, policies for Sale events can be configured at the Sale checkpoint, and they will be applied to orders created via requests to this endpoint.
